sources.title: Humane Intelligence Inc nonprofit tax record EIN 93-1491311

reading.body:
Humane Intelligence is recorded as a 2022 Texas nonprofit with no AI products, no litigation, and no MCP servers, but 126 Texas law exposure entries.

The only substantial data point is the law exposure count. Everything else in the record is an absence: no products, no cases, no MCP servers, no aliases. A nonprofit founded in 2022 and headquartered in Katy, Texas, with a website that returned only a placeholder message at collection time, leaves almost nothing to characterize what the organization actually does.

The 126 Texas law exposure entries are the one figure that carries weight, and the data does not explain what they represent. They could be filings, citations, or registry entries. Without that definition, the count cannot be read as risk, activity, or scale. It is a number attached to a Texas code reference and nothing more.

For AI specifically, this record supports no claim about compute, data centers, or power. There is no product, no infrastructure, and no disclosed operation to connect to the grid. The honest reading is that the data is thin, and the absences should be treated as gaps in collection rather than as facts about the organization.
